name: ESN SMP
description:
ESN SMP is a survival SMP with an RPG twist, running on our own custom ESN plugin. Java and Bedrock players play together (crossplay through Geyser), and keepInventory is ON, so a death never costs you your gear.

What you'll find:

- KOTH battles for loot and bragging rights

- Jobs (miner, farmer, hunter, fisher) that pay in-game coins

- Seasonal events (the Halloween event is live now, with more every season)

- Custom ESN weapons and armor with their own textures (optional resource pack, offered when you join)

- Realm worlds unlocked with realm keys and guarded by bosses

- Clans, crates, a black market and championships

How to join:

Java: play.esnoffical.com (port 25565), version 26.3

Bedrock: play.esnoffical.com, port 19132

Discord: https://discord.gg/RGPt3zEfGy

Website: https://esnoffical.com
